Package io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    Tag<T>
    Java-8 universal port: drop-in replacement for org.bukkit.Tag (1.13+).
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BlockDataCompat
    Java-8 universal port: routes every org.bukkit.block.data.* operation through reflection so those modern (MC 1.13+) types never appear in any other class's bytecode.
    BukkitSerialization
    Serialize a Bukkit Inventory to or from a String.
    HandCompat
    Reflective helpers for the 1.9+ off-hand API (getHand/getItemInOffHand/EquipmentSlot), so handlers run on 1.8.
    HoloMessage
    This utility class is used to display a holographic pop up using the HologramsAPI.
    ItemGlow
    Utility class to add an enchantment glint to items using the modern ItemMeta#setEnchantmentGlintOverride(Boolean) API.
    MaterialCompat
    Java-8 universal port: resolves an XMaterial to the running server's Material, guaranteeing a non-null result.
    MaterialConverter Deprecated
    We should replace this some day.
    RecipeCompat
    Java-8 universal port: builds keyed recipes (ShapedRecipe, ShapelessRecipe, FurnaceRecipe) version-safely.
    SoilSaturation
    Manage the "saturation" level of a block for the purposes of STB farming tools.
    SoundCompat
    Java-8 universal port: plays sounds by their modern (1.9+) enum name, resolving version-safely.
    STBUtil
    A collection of miscellaneous utility methods.
    SunlightLevels  
    VanillaInventoryUtils
    Utility methods to interact with vanilla inventories.
